social.text:
I've been critical of @MikeHaridopolos lack of awareness, consideration, and meaningful response as our community struggles to recover from the flooding.

Today, met with boos, he joined the Mayor of Palm Bay for a press conference celebrating the reopening of a road. A project he had no role in, standing alongside a mayor whose relationship with Haridopolos needed repair after it was reported the Mayor left amid ethical concerns in the office.

But the reality facing residents couldn't be further from a ribbon-cutting moment.

Frustrated residents showed up with legitimate questions and concerns. They deserved answers, acknowledgment, and a willingness to listen. Instead, it highlighted just how disconnected these representatives are from what people are actually going through. 

I'm proud of the residents who showed up, spoke out, and demanded better. They deserve to be heard.

And as our community braces for yet another weather event that could bring damaging amounts of rain, let's look out for one another.

Check on your neighbors, especially those still recovering from the flooding. If you have the time, consider volunteering to help families who are still trying to put their lives back together.

Glad the criticism has him concerned and paying attention. But, our community needs more than press conferences. It needs people willing to show up. Stop worrying about your manicure Mike and throw on some gloves 💛
